name: cold_offer_v1
hypothesis: Chasing a firm's first 50 old quotes for free gets more positive replies (and more calls) from UK window/door installers than chasing them on a pay-per-booked-survey basis, because it removes all risk of saying yes.
variable: offer line in the first email (subject, opener, the homeowner text, ask and follow-up 2 identical)
decision_rule: After min_sent_per_arm first emails per arm: keep the arm with >= 90% probability of the higher positive-reply rate. If neither reaches 90%, keep the arm that produced more booked calls and move on - the difference is too small to matter at our volume.

arms.subject: last year's quotes
arms.body:
Hi,

Ever had a homeowner ring back months after a quote, ready to go?

Most don't. So I'd text the ones {company} quoted last year, from your name:

"Hi, it's {company}. We quoted for your windows a while back. Did you ever get that sorted?"

Anyone still keen goes in your diary. You only pay for surveys that get booked.

Worth a go?

sequence_note: 2 emails per company (decided 2026-10-11): email 1 + follow-up 2 at +3 business days; follow-up 3 is never sent.
